title: Machine learning analysis of SERS fingerprinting for the rapid determination of Mycobacterium tuberculosis infection and drug resistance
summary: Deep-learning classifiers applied to handheld surface-enhanced Raman spectra distinguished sputum samples with or without Mycobacterium tuberculosis (five-fold accuracy 94.32%), pulmonary from extrapulmonary isolates (99.86%), and isolate drug-resistance profiles (99.59%). These results are specific to the studied samples and do not establish clinical deployment. The result remains bounded to the reported datasets and assays.
